# SnipFor

> SnipFor is a fast, lightweight screen capture and OCR tool for Windows, built around a "Zero Data Leak" principle: screen content and extracted text never leave the user's computer. No cloud processing, no data upload.

## What it does

- Capture a selected area, a window, or the full screen (pixel-precise selection, multi-monitor and 4K DPI support).
- Extract text from anything on screen (a paused video, a remote desktop session, a PDF that doesn't allow copy-paste) using a fully local, embedded Tesseract OCR engine.
- Annotate captures instantly: arrows, highlighter, shapes, text, auto-incrementing numbered stamps, blur/pixelate for sensitive data.
- Pin captured snippets on top of other windows for quick reference.
- Undo/redo up to 30 steps, color picker, clipboard sync (PNG/BMP).

## Editions

- **Community** (free): core capture, annotation, local OCR, screen pinning.
- **Pro**: adds video recording. Purchase/upgrade info at https://snipfor.com
- **Audit**: commercial edition for enterprise/compliance teams (MSI installer, code hardening, enterprise deployment). Not publicly listed; contact mehmet@nevresoglu.net.
